title: A Asset for the Drop
author: P. M. Fairweather
blurb: Odile Marchetti, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
